name: OmniRoute
title_zh: 一个免费网关接 352 家模型，断线自动切换
tagline_zh: Claude Code 里配一次，就能白嫖 150+ 免费模型。Kimi、GPT、Gemini 随便换。
tagline_en: One config in Claude Code unlocks 150+ free models. Auto-switch on failure, save up to 95% tokens. 550.
desc_en: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 352 providers (150+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by 550+ contributors
why_zh: 配额感知的自动回退是灵魂：不是简单轮询，而是知道每个 provider 还剩多少额度，专挑能用的上。
why_en: Quota-aware fallback isn't round-robin—it knows each provider's remaining credits and picks what works. RTK+Caveman compression.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
